title: Watershed Science
subject: Stream health · Water quality
blurb: Walk a stream from forest to farm to town. Kick-net aquatic insects, test the water, calculate a water-quality index and track down a pollution source.

title: Biodiversity Field Station
subject: Biodiversity · Ecology
blurb: Survey plants and fungi with quadrats in a meadow, a forest and a disturbed lot. Measure species richness and Simpson's diversity, spot an invasive species and recommend how to protect the habitat.

title: Life Science Lab
subject: Food webs · Evolution · Photosynthesis
blurb: An indoor lab with three live experiments: remove predators from a food web, watch birds drive natural selection, and measure photosynthesis with a lamp and a water plant.

title: Cell Biology Bench
subject: Cell culture · Lab technique
blurb: Practice real cell-culture lab protocols step by step: feeding cells, drug treatment, counting cells under the microscope. Built by the Voss Lab (opens in a new tab; content CC-BY 4.0, code LGPL-3.0).

title: Eutrophication Lake
subject: Nutrient pollution · Aquatic ecosystems
blurb: Sample a lake as fertilizer runoff triggers an algal bloom, then trace the dissolved-oxygen crash and fish kill.

title: Coral Reef & Ocean Lab
subject: Oceanography · Ocean acidification
blurb: Dive a reef to measure bleaching, water temperature and pH, and connect them to rising CO2.

title: Climate & Carbon Center
subject: Climate change · Carbon cycle
blurb: Track carbon through the atmosphere, oceans and forests, and test how policies change future warming.

title: Soil & Sustainable Farm
subject: Agriculture · Soil science
blurb: Dig soil pits, test soil texture and nutrients, and compare conventional and sustainable farming.

title: Renewable Energy Park
subject: Energy resources · Sustainability
blurb: Site wind turbines and solar arrays, measure output, and weigh land use and wildlife trade-offs.
